series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): When high school midterm exam results are posted, Rentaro celebrates alongside Hakari, Karane, and Shizuka until top-ranked prodigy Nano Eiai passes by. A sudden lock of eyes triggers a blinding Zing shock, revealing Nano as Rentaro’s fourth destined soulmate.
Prior events (Part 2): Rentaro learns that Nano Eiai organizes her entire life around absolute efficiency, rejecting normal food for nutrient paste and scorning social interaction. When Rentaro attempts to approach her in the hallway with juice and conversation, she coldly brushes him aside as a total waste of time.
